experiment: per-connected-component repair plus a finalist-combination beam for the joint multi-piece re-placement tier (mode 29), and the rerun of the ladders its original negative was measured on

whatWasWrongWithTheOriginal.pooledEjectionSet: the pass unioned every pair-bearing violation component into a single ejection set (general_persistent_vacancy.rs ~2343, LayoutViolations::pair_component_slots). Four independent two-piece conflicts therefore refused on an ejection cap that none of them individually trips: 27 of the original 63 refusals were this artifact, with no infeasibility certificate behind them.
whatWasWrongWithTheOriginal.greedyFirstFinalist: the shared insertion primitive committed the first in-bound finalist for every piece with no backtracking (~1468). A component whose first piece takes the shallowest pose and thereby boxes the second one out was refused outright.
whatWasWrongWithTheOriginal.cyclicOrdersOnly: above four pieces the order search degenerates to rotations of the canonical order (~2146). Unchanged - but with per-component repair, components above four pieces are now rare.

fix.perComponent: the pass repairs one connected violation component at a time and re-surveys the whole layout between components, up to JOINT_REPLACEMENT_COMPONENT_PASSES = 8. Components are taken in descending incident violation mass with the lowest slot index breaking ties, on an integer grid key so the choice cannot depend on float comparison order. A component that fails is recorded and skipped rather than retried.
fix.acceptance: the authoritative whole-request validator whenever it passes - which is what a single-component instance is decided on, so that case is behaviourally what it always was. Only while other conflict clusters are still outstanding may a pass accept partial progress: this component's pairs cleared and the boundary residue no worse. Publication is unchanged: only a layout validate_and_measure_placements accepts ever leaves the pass.
fix.combinationBeam: for components of at most JOINT_REPLACEMENT_BEAM_MAX_PIECES = 3 pieces the pass enumerates combinations of finalist ranks - CONSTRUCTION_FINALISTS_PER_SLOT = 4 ranks per piece, 4^3 = 64 combinations - in odometer order with the all-zeros combination (the greedy commit) first. The primitive gained a finalist_choice parameter; every other caller passes None and is bit-identical.
fix.planOrder: plain insertion orders, then the pose-swap round, then the beam. The beam runs last deliberately: every state the tier used to publish it still publishes by exactly the route it used to, so the change can only ADD publications.
fix.budgets: no new aggregate quota term. JointReplacementBudget charges every attempt against a slot ceiling that is exactly the product the single-set pass was already funded for (JOINT_REPLACEMENT_ORDER_CAP + JOINT_REPLACEMENT_SWAP_ROUNDS * JOINT_REPLACEMENT_SWAP_ATTEMPT_CAP) * piece_count, plus an attempt ceiling of JOINT_REPLACEMENT_COMPONENT_PASSES * (orders + swaps + beam). Both are asserted in bounded_reinsertion_fits_the_construction_budget, extended in the same commit; an instance too small to fund the plan stops on capExhausted.

ladders.description: the record and from-scratch ladders the original negative was measured on, rerun on the fixed tier

verdict: The mechanical objection is upheld and fixed: 27 of the original 63 refusals were a pooled-cap artifact and that class is now zero, the greedy first-finalist commit now has 64-combination backtracking on small components, and the tier repairs components it previously could not even attempt (1 component actually repaired per multi-cluster state). The scientific conclusion is UNCHANGED: on the deep-frontier residue of both certified locks the joint tier still publishes nothing, and both locks still return their incumbent at every seed. What was an artifact-contaminated negative is now a measured one - the residue at these depths is over-compression whose components individually have no in-bound pose, not a mis-arrangement any ordering, exchange or pose combination reaches.
note: the same fixed tier IS productive on the perturbation class: see compression-negatives-corrected/ and record-164.042/, where a nudge-induced residue of two- and three-piece components legalizes below the record. The difference is the residue's scale, not the tier's reach.
